buyingFormat.description: Filter by listing format. Leave blank for both.
buyingFormat.title: Buying Format

condition.description: Filter by item condition. Leave blank for all conditions.
condition.title: Item Condition

keywords.description: Search eBay by keyword (e.g., 'laptop', 'vintage watch'). Builds a search URL automatically — no need to construct one yourself. Leave blank if using Start URLs instead.
keywords.title: Search Keywords

marketplace.description: Which eBay country site to search.
marketplace.title: Marketplace

maxItems.description: Maximum number of items to scrape across all provided URLs.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxPrice.description: Maximum item price filter (in the marketplace's local currency).
maxPrice.title: Maximum Price

minPrice.description: Minimum item price filter (in the marketplace's local currency).
minPrice.title: Minimum Price

proxy.description: Required — eBay blocks datacenter IPs. Use residential proxy for reliable results.
proxy.title: Proxy Configuration

sortBy.description: Result sort order. Leave blank for eBay's default best-match relevance.
sortBy.title: Sort Order

startUrls.description: Direct eBay search or category URLs to scrape, as an alternative or addition to keyword search. Supports search results pages and category pages.
startUrls.sectionCaption: Also get results from custom URLs
startUrls.title: Start URLs
